title: URAファイナルズ予選の後に

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Bravo! Congratulations on passing the preliminaries!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Umamusume competing on the stage where they can shine the brightest, their fans' expectations on their backs…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: The satisfaction on the faces of both the runners and the crowd…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid! This is truly what the URA Finale is all about!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But the next race won't be so easy. You'll be up against fellow veterans who've made it through the preliminaries just like you. What do you say to that?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Excellent! I look forward to a heated race!
